function-tool-migration.description: Known Function Tool migration, recovery, deleted-lane, retained-midpoint, and deterministic progress regressions; supplemental only

model-provider-recovery.description: Offline shared model contact policy, exact typed continuation across independent answers and Passes, source-built retry, findings-changing effort stops and output-only holds; live recovery remains separate

planning-attempt-defect-reproducers.description: Reproducers of inherited planning-path defects: failed planning Attempts that read back with their exact failure source (fixed by #143), accepted-worker binding errors that escaped advance (fixed by #145), and a transport-aware preparation request (the coordinator's since #301) that the Journey writer's preparation_review admission admits over its semantic-only prefix, whose preparation context reads no transport or contact evidence (fixed by #144), and the planning output question that only the coordinator asks, with an Attempt that closes when nothing is offered (fixed by #146), and a TaxId organism assertion whose discovery or supplied-accession inspection repeated the raw taxonomy query instead of offering its refinements (fixed by #149), and planning requirements no source can satisfy that ended the Run or crashed a contact-free planning rerun (fixed by #207); supplemental only

tests.test_cli.description: Representative depth for the CLI adapter (#278): the public scientific continuation through the real contact-free pipeline, cross-process observer nouns and framing, observer-driven begin/answer and interactive begin, review choices, response-file and stage-selector refusals, a missing credential hold, a configuration fault before any Journey, an invalid answer leaving the Run waiting, and captured-request conflicts; supplemental only

tests.test_default_agentic_loop.description: Representative depth for the default agentic loop (#278): the tool registry and stage tool sets, continuation progress, premature-call refusal, an attempt ending at its researcher question, two ordered calls with their own receipts, a failing first call and an exhausted refusal allowance, bounded Journey search, stage findings, and negative-result, transient-fault, operational-fault and model-recovery paths; supplemental only

tests.test_execution_application_integra.description: Representative depth for Execution through the application (#278): verified Execution with a captured request reaching collection review, the CLI investigation begin supplying the request inside one pass, adaptive composition stopping at planning review, exact approval as the only authority fact, dispatch interruption and replay without repeated effects, reject as terminal, reopen refusals on corrupted selection, and the absent preparation question Tool; supplemental only

tests.test_execution_planning_agent.description: Representative depth for the execution planning agent (#278): an execution revision re-entering planning with its instruction visible, the unchanged planning tool contract, ungrounded recipe lookup and no-compatible-recipe returns to the model, a capability-error attempt reading back, and generic observation of an unexpected selection failure; supplemental only

tests.test_finalization.description: Representative depth for Finalization (#278): public compile, inspect, approve and reopen digest-bound and contact-free, retained-owner byte reuse with stale-history refusal, input abort and finalization stop reopening without a report, and an accounting-only basis; supplemental only

tests.test_grounded_report.description: Representative depth for the grounded report (#278): public publish and reopen deterministic, grounded and projection-equivalent, and reopen refusing an unverifiable artifact without contact or mutation; supplemental only

tests.test_h100_stage.description: Representative depth for the H100 stage (#278): full operation verifying outputs and reopening without contact, the real job runner consuming the H100 recipe, public BAM/VCF materialization, inert artifact export, failed-submission retry, replacement then publication retry, placement failure before submission, missing durable validation, contact review binding, and disk-quantity validation; supplemental only

tests.test_operation.description: Representative depth for the post-HITL operation module (#201): one approved execution flow, its first contact failure, a changed-input refusal, interrupted-pass replay, and production construction through actual callers; supplemental only

tests.test_planning_assignment.description: Representative depth for planning assignment (#278): the application combining input, plan, reference and history, refused-call continuation, configuration and pre-response faults, re-entry and invalid-action holds, source failure and transport, exhausted and unresolved taxon questions, supplied exact reference reopen, history read without unapproved Execution, and slot-producer tools; supplemental only

tests.test_reference_stages.description: Representative depth for the reference stages (#278): no-candidate preparation through H100, completed-job reuse with the real job runner, the offline harness across both stage seams, a bound prebuilt index's miss then exact approval, decline, submission failure and exhaustion, and placement refusal; supplemental only

tests.test_run_observation_application.description: Representative depth for Run observation through the application (#278): begin advancing to planning review, contact-free observe and resume at a pending review, public dependency binding, holds on dispatch, untyped error and changed worker digest, a durable hold lift, scoped reject and abort, terminal planning stop, total status routing, and a premature recipe call refused at the settled-output gate; supplemental only

tests.test_sequential_investigation.description: Representative depth for sequential investigation (#201): selected approval, observation and reopen through the public path, observation failure propagation, a corrected public begin, collection attempt order, total fold states, stale partial-review refusal, and contact-free finalization reopen; supplemental only

tests.test_shared_review_responses.description: Representative depth for shared review responses (#278): the CLI finalization response publishing the exact approved basis from the shared executed parent, and a selected approval observing from the Run's own inputs whose replay writes nothing (#107); supplemental only
